answers.core: For the reasons stated above I think it should be a core feature. It's a super small change that shouldn't have any negative side effects, while making plugin development a bit nicer. I would be willing to implement this feature.
answers.workaround: Yes, this can be worked around. However the workaround is not a very clean way to do this. It also depends on an implementation detail (settings being also properties). Exposing a dedicated method would decouple code accessing the settings list from the implementation detail.
